# Centigram/Lernout & Hauspie TruVoice

Now **REBORN**, and using the decompiled version of TruVoice. All with the assistance of Claude Opus 5.5.

This is the command line program for using Centigram's TruVoice text-to-speech system.

TruVoice is the successor to the Speech Plus Prose 2000 since Centigram acquired Speech Plus in the early 90s.

Check out quickguide.txt for how to use the program.

The code for the speak window is released under MIT. the included DLLs (and decompiled code by extension) for TruVoice is proprietary abandonware.
